reason: Unpackaged /usr/local FPM pools (official Docker images) are deliberately not de-duplicated because binary identity is not established, so at ~19 advisories identical pool children can still push out the CLI (reported blocked); a runtime-path identity would allow safe de-duplication. An inventory that alone nears 1024 facts still aborts the report (max(1, ...)). CHANGELOG must qualify the pool-worker fix as packaged-only. PR #13 defines MAX_REPORT_FACTS with a different (whole-report) meaning: rebase risk.
